summary: Multi-line code block with a title, a “word wrap” button, and copy to clipboard.
whenNotToUse: Short snippets within text: use Code.

props.name: language
props.description: Language label, displayed and used in the accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: Appearance: `window` shows a dark editor window with three decorative dots, ideal for landing pages and heroes.

inherits: HTML attributes of <div>; ref to the container.

keyboard.action: Reaches the buttons and then the code area (scrollable with the arrow keys).

accessibility: The code area is a named region, focusable for keyboard scrolling.
The copy result (success or error) is announced in a live region.
“Word wrap” is a toggle with aria-pressed.
In the window variant the three dots are decorative (aria-hidden).
responsive: Below 640 px the “Copy” label is kept only for screen readers; horizontal scrolling is local to the block.
commonMistakes: Relying on copy in insecure contexts (http): the Clipboard API may be unavailable and an error is shown.

examples.name: Window
examples.title: Editor window
examples.description: `window` variant with a dark bar and dots, as in landing page snippets.

limits: No built-in syntax highlighting (to avoid adding dependencies); the consumer can preprocess the code.
